title: Stalks of the pushforward along a closed immersion
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the stalks of the pushforward of a sheaf along a closed immersion: the stalk is a singleton at geometric points outside Z and the stalk of the original sheaf at geometric points inside Z (statement lines 6643-6659). The proof treats the two cases separately: outside Z the author uses that an etale neighbourhood can be shrunk away from Z (proof lines 6661-6667), and inside Z the stalk is identified through the comparison of the filtered colimits defining both stalks (proof lines 6670-6699). The non-formal content is the comparison in the second case. The claim is H2: two short computations.
